summary: Iteration 3 — Badminton Academy Manager. 15 pytest cases covering Settings, Payout-basis (expected vs collected math), Undo payment/payout flows incl. expense soft-delete, Public /auth/register-full + /auth/public-sessions, Stripe checkout-session creation, and Resend email (test + bulk reminders). Result: 14 PASS, 1 XFAIL — Stripe GET /api/billing/checkout-status/{id} returns 500 due to emergentintegrations library pydantic validation bug. Kishore expected-basis payslip math confirmed: expected_revenue × 30% == payout_amount and payout_basis=='expected'. Undo-paid on coach payout correctly soft-deletes auto-created 'Coach Payout' expense (notes contains payout id). Frontend smoke verified: /register-student loads publicly (Step 1 of 3 visible), /login has 'Register your child →' link to /register-student, /admin/settings renders 3 tabs (Academy, Payout Basis, Email) with all form fields, parent payments page renders with 'Pay by card (Stripe)' helper text (no pending dues for tested parent so Pay-now button row not exercised).

critical.issue: Returns 500. Root cause: emergentintegrations.payments.stripe.checkout.get_checkout_status raises CheckoutError — Pydantic validation error: CheckoutStatusResponse.metadata expects dict but Stripe SDK returns a StripeObject. This breaks parent-side payment confirmation polling entirely. Webhook path also uses the same client but only writes via handle_webhook; polling-based confirmation (the documented test path) is unusable.

minor.issue: Returns sent=N but Resend backend rejects most emails ('You can only send testing emails to your own email address (blnobadminton@gmail.com)') and rate-limits (5 req/s). The endpoint counts attempts not actual deliveries; sent counter is misleading. Consider tracking success/failure separately or batching/throttling to 5 req/s.

Returns ok:true even when Resend errors out with a deliverability rejection (only blnobadminton@gmail.com permitted). Per review_request note this is acceptable, but the `ok` flag should reflect actual success.

Expense soft-delete uses {notes: {$regex: pid}} — if a future migration changes the notes format, the link breaks. Safer to store payout_id as a first-class field on the expense doc and match by that.

integration_issues.issue: Parent Payments.jsx polls /api/billing/checkout-status/{session_id}, which 500s due to backend library bug. Even after a real Stripe payment, the parent's payment will NOT auto-flip to 'paid' via polling.

issues: Academy tab fields render correctly; no missing fields. Save settings button visible. Tabs (Academy / Payout Basis / Email) work.
Step 1 of 3 form renders cleanly; progress bar visible. Sign-in link present.

action_items: HIGH: Fix /api/billing/checkout-status — wrap sc.get_checkout_status in try/except and fall back to a direct Stripe SDK call (stripe.checkout.Session.retrieve) to bypass the emergentintegrations Pydantic CheckoutStatusResponse.metadata validation bug. Alternatively, patch emergentintegrations or pin to a version where metadata accepts StripeObject. WEB-SEARCH recommended on emergentintegrations CheckoutStatusResponse metadata validation if patch is unclear.
MED: Email send-dues-reminders should track and return {sent, failed, rate_limited} separately instead of a single optimistic counter; add per-request throttling to respect Resend's 5 req/s.
LOW: Store coach_payout_id as a first-class field on the auto-created expense (instead of relying on notes regex) so undo-paid expense soft-delete is robust.
LOW: 'Reset' or restore the test-mutated academy_settings (name='BLno Test' was set by an earlier test patch — not cleaned up). Add teardown to settings PATCH test or restore name on test exit.
critical_code_review_comments: billing_routes.checkout_status — no try/except around sc.get_checkout_status. Any library exception bubbles as 500; the polling client (parent payments) gets no useful state.
auth_routes.register_full — age computed from dob via fromisoformat; passing a partial date string (e.g. '2015') would crash before the except. Acceptable since UI sends ISO.

auth_routes.register_full — fire-and-forget asyncio.create_task(send_email(...)) inside a request handler can be cancelled when the response completes if uvicorn drops the task; consider BackgroundTasks instead.
email_routes._send_sync — no retry on Resend 429 (rate limit). Bulk reminders WILL drop emails silently.

finance_routes.calculate_payouts — 'expected' basis aggregates payments where status != 'failed'; but pending payments may not have been generated yet for the period. Result could be 0 if generate-monthly was skipped. Acceptable but worth noting in UI ('No expected revenue — run Generate Monthly first').
settings_routes.set_payout_basis — only updates active rules; if no active rule exists for the coach, returns ok:true silently. Consider returning the modified_count so UI can warn.

billing_routes._client — uses request.base_url (the internal preview host) for webhook_url; if Stripe is configured with a different webhook endpoint URL in dashboard, the runtime webhook_url constructed here is unused/decorative.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 test parent + 1 student via /auth/register-full (test_iter3_<ts>@example.com). Settings name was incidentally PATCHed to 'BLno Test' by an earlier run and not restored — restore in next iteration or via UI.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Stripe polling 500 is the only blocker — fix in billing_routes.checkout_status. iter3_test.py is idempotent and re-runnable. The Resend test address restriction is by design (per review_request); treat 200 with internal Resend error as PASS for email_test endpoint. Public registration successfully creates users; do NOT delete the test_iter3_* parents (they're idempotent-named via timestamp). The CORS issue flagged in iter2 is resolved on shuttle-flow.preview.emergentagent.com (same-origin); review_request mentioned a 6e9f5c4d-... host but REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL still points to shuttle-flow — verify with main agent which host is canonical.
rca_of_the_issue: Stripe 500: emergentintegrations.payments.stripe.checkout.get_checkout_status returns a CheckoutStatusResponse pydantic model whose `metadata` field is typed as dict; Stripe SDK returns metadata as a StripeObject which fails pydantic v2 strict dict validation. Stack trace: 'Input should be a valid dictionary [type=dict_type, input_value=<StripeObject at 0x...>, input_type=StripeObject]'. Mitigation: in checkout_status endpoint, wrap call in try/except and on failure call stripe.checkout.Session.retrieve(session_id) directly to read status/payment_status, OR coerce metadata to dict(metadata) before model_validate. The webhook path is unaffected because handle_webhook does not deserialize the metadata field the same way.
